dataset: State and Union Territory Assembly constituency slots
source_scope: Karnataka names retained from the existing project and supplied 2008 delimitation reference. Jammu and Kashmir names and reservations replaced from the supplied 2022 final delimitation papers. Other state/UT seat counts use current assembly sizes; names remain explicitly fictional placeholders pending authoritative constituency lists. This dataset is not yet a fully verified real-world constituency-name database. Andhra Pradesh and Arunachal Pradesh records retained from their verified state patches; Bihar names and reservation categories added from ECI 2025 election schedules. Chhattisgarh and Goa names and reservation categories added from ECI election constituency schedules. Gujarat and Haryana constituency names and reservation categories verified against ECI/PIB election schedules. Telangana and Tripura constituency names from user-provided Legislative Assembly Constituencies Directory; game-defined 3% SC and 3% ST allocation (rounded to whole seats), not official reservation mapping. Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand constituency names from user-provided Legislative Assembly Constituencies Directory; game-defined 3% SC and 3% ST allocation (rounded to whole seats), not official reservation mapping. Corrected duplicate fictional placeholder rows for Telangana and Tripura in this cumulative data file. West Bengal and Delhi constituency names added from supplied directory PDF; 3% SC and 3% ST categories are custom game allocations, not official reservation mappings.
